Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from 2 November says the same: "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

Your own cutover recap from 8 December 2025 gives the same date for the official handoff. It adds that you kept running PHL day to day through 21 November to finish the terminal cutover. Kwame then took over day-to-day on 22 November.

If the tracker needs an ownership date, use 3 Nov 2025. If it tracks who was actually running the account, use 22 Nov 2025.
